blocks.text: Event-based analytics for understanding how users engage with your product

Mixpanel pioneered event-based analytics and remains the leader for product teams that need deep behavioral insights. Instead of tracking page views, Mixpanel tracks what users do - every button click, feature use, and conversion step becomes a queryable event.

The self-serve analytics interface is where Mixpanel shines. Product managers and analysts can build complex queries, create funnels, analyze retention cohorts, and slice data by any user property - all without writing SQL or requesting reports from a data team.

For product-led companies, Mixpanel answers the questions that drive growth: Where do users drop off? Which features correlate with retention? What distinguishes power users from churning users? These insights directly inform product decisions.
Track custom events and user actions with unlimited properties
Multi-step conversion analysis with drop-off identification
Cohort-based retention analysis to measure product stickiness
Visualize the paths users take through your product
Slice data by any user property or behavioral cohort
Automated alerts when metrics change significantly
Mixpanel's event-based approach gives product teams the behavioral insights that page-view analytics miss. Understanding what users do inside your product is essential for product-led growth.
Our team can integrate Mixpanel into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
